name: Jincao Plot
description: Cultivation plot adjusted for growing Jincao, with a higher chance of Fluffed Jincao. Soil quality is far better than the average arable land in Wuling. The wiki does not list a structured in-game recipe for operating the plot; the only Crafting table on the wiki is for building the plot itself (Jincao Seed + Carbon -> Jincao Plot). Rarity 2.
